description.value: Liquor 4 Less (branded Liquor For Less) is a private liquor retail chain with six Fraser Valley locations across Abbotsford and Langley. The Highstreet Mall location is the chain's original Abbotsford store, formerly operating as Mt. Lehman Liquor Store, and carries a broad selection of beer, wine, and spirits. It has been voted a local favourite liquor store and winery/wine store by community readers.
